headline: At 83.3 %, full-time employment is clearly the strongest signal here, well above regional and overall levels.
how_to_read: Left: all respondents; middle: employed or not; right: detailed situation, widths showing share of respondents. Branch totals are hidden, so branches show a lower bound (≥) and the hatched 'Hidden' stream runs directly from Respondents.
key_findings: Full-time work accounts for 83.3 % of respondents, while seeking work, student, retired and other situation are all 0.0 %.
Part-time, self-employed, not seeking work and both totals are hidden (fewer than 3 people).
benchmark: Full-time work exceeds the regional 74.2 % by 9.1 pp and the 74.9 % across all schools by 8.4 pp. With the totals hidden, it is unclear whether this lifts overall employment.
caveats: With n = 42, the hidden cells mean the not-employed side cannot be judged.
